يعترضوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَرِضُوا (yaʕtariḍū) /jaʕ.ta.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# يُعْتَرَضُوا (yuʕtaraḍū) /juʕ.ta.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
